7-day event (one short task per day) + 7 days of bonus

Seasonal event (5 to 12 August) at the {wiki:Great Expedition Wharf}, near Fibula. Every day {npc:Proprietor Piers} gives a group task at the shipyard; completing it earns you Event Points and a vote for a bonus for your world. You trade the points for rubber ducks, the Captain outfit, the Landsailer mount and exploration gear.

Support Proprietor Piers and join the Great Expedition in Thais. Work with your friends to keep the shipyard safe and the construction going, so that this venture gets under way. Gather the perfect crew for the voyage and sail towards new horizons!
World requirement: 35,000,000 gold coins in total donations (5,000,000 per day) and 50 votes per day for the world to advance.
Some days require several players at the same time (day 3: 4 barrels; day 5: minimum 4 players; day 6: human chain).
Nothing mandatory. Optional gold to donate and earn extra Event Points.
Global bonuses for your world during the rewards week (one per day, depending on the vote)
Event Points: 5 for each daily task + points for donations
{wiki:Captains Outfits|Captain} outfit (70 points), {item:Landsailer} mount (140 points), rubber ducks and exploration equipment
Draw for ultra-exclusive prizes for those who collect at least 70 Event Points (if the world completes all 7 days)
When you trade **140 Event Points**, at any stage of the event.
Only during the event (5 to 12 August).
Talk to {npc:Proprietor Piers} every day of the event: each day has a new task worth 5 Event Points.
After each task, do not forget to go back to Piers to **vote** ({key:A} or {key:B}): that is where you get the points.
Points can be exchanged at any phase of the event.
Collect at least 70 points to enter the final draw.
The event runs from 5 to 12 August at the {wiki:Great Expedition Wharf} (Fibula), followed by 7 days of bonuses.
Getting to the Great Expedition Wharf

The event shipyard is in {wiki:Fibula}, the small island **southwest** of Thais. From Thais, cross the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} ({coord:32261,32385,7}) or use the teleport on the 2nd floor of the Knightwatch Tower. In Fibula look for {npc:Proprietor Piers} at the shipyard. To come back, take the same route in reverse through the Fibula Tunnel to Thais.
Fibula Tunnel (path between Thais and Fibula)
You earn Event Points in two ways: by completing the daily task (5 points each, 7 days) or by donating gold to Piers.
Condition for the world to advance
For the world to move on to the next day (and earn that day's bonus), **50 votes** must be cast and at least **5,000,000 gold coins** donated that day.
Talk to {npc:Proprietor Piers}: woodworm are eating the building materials. Say {key:help}.

Next to Piers and one floor down there are pesticide flasks of various colours. Use a flask to put it in your backpack and then use it on a woodworm of the **same colour**. Repeat until you receive the message *"SUCCESS! You repelled the worms! A new hunt is about to begin!"*.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = 40% chance of doubled progress in the Bestiary; {key:B} = doubled respawn rate.
Piers says moles are ruining the resources. Say {key:help}.

Next to Piers and at other spots on the surface there are hammers (mole hammers). Use one to put it in your backpack and then use it on the mole burrows to destroy them. Repeat until you receive *"SUCCESS! The moles have been driven off!"*.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +5% experience; {key:B} = +5% critical rate.
Piers says all the sauerkraut has to be taken to Estrela. Say {key:help}.

Go down the stairs and walk **southwest**: you find {item:Sauerkraut Barrel|Sauerkraut Barrels}. Push them to the centre. Coordinate with other players so that there are **4 barrels in the centre at the same time**. If it goes well, you receive a server message.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +5% life leech; {key:B} = +3% mana leech.
Piers wants to speed up deliveries with a catapult system. Say {key:help}.
Stay in the **south** area, next to Piers, until the message *"CATAPULT DELIVERY SYSTEM IS STARTING!"* appears. The event repeats every **2 minutes**.

You have **50 seconds** to deliver at least **7 crates** to the crate area, on the other side of the wall, north of Piers. For each crate: stand on one of the red circles (*throwing target*), wait until you are turned into a crate and run in that form to the crate area (green zone in the image), stepping on it. If it goes well, you get *"EXCELLENT PERFORMANCE!"*.
Red throwing circles and green crate delivery zone
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +20% XP from Bounty Tasks; {key:B} = +10% Shared XP bonus.
Piers wants to clear the heavy cargo that is clogging the shipyard. Say {key:help}.
Pull the rope as a group

Go down the stairs and go to the **northeast** section of the shipyard. At least **4 players** are needed. Each one stands on one of the spots next to the wooden fence and pulls the central rope (click **Use**). At least 4 players have to pull within **5 seconds**, counting from the first pull.
Spots next to the fence and the central rope
Taking the cargo to the end
Repeat the process until the cargo reaches the last platform, where it disappears. If it goes well, you get *"EXCELLENT! NEXT DELIVERY!"*.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +10% XP; {key:B} = +15% loot.
Piers wants to light up the ship using an abundant source of energy. Say {key:help}.

Go down the stairs and go to the power room, in the **northwest** section. You have to carry the electricity from the source (Energizer), next to the **east** wall of the room, to the target in the middle of the room (Generator). Form a **human chain** with several players, with at most **3 sqm** between each one. It works with up to 12 players (5 recommended).
Power room: from the Energizer to the Generator
Delivering the charge to the generator
To succeed you have to be **on the iron floor next to the generator, in skeleton form**, when the blue glow appears. If it goes well, you get *"SUCCESS! Charge Delivered!"*.
Iron floor next to the generator
You can run in skeleton form to the Power-hungry Ship-generator and do it with fewer players; very fast characters can even do it solo.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +20% XP from Bounty Tasks; {key:B} = +10% Shared XP bonus.
Piers warns that the shipyard is on fire. Say {key:help}.
When the message *"FIRE! Extinguish the flames!"* appears, spots with ashes show up all over Piers' area. The event repeats every **3 minutes**.

You have **3 minutes** to put out at least **30 fires** with a water bucket, which you find **south** of Piers. Each spot cycles between three states: ashes, glowing ashes and fire. **Only the last two** can be put out with the bucket. If it goes well, you get *"SUCCESS! The fires are under control for now!"*.
Fire states: ashes, glowing ashes and fire
You can carry several buckets to save time, but they disappear from your inventory if you do not use them within 2.5 minutes.
Go back to Piers and vote: {key:A} = +15% loot; {key:B} = +10% XP.
At the end of the event, all winning bonuses become active at the same time during the rewards week. Each day, one of the two options wins:
40% chance of doubled progress in the Bestiary

Each duck costs **25 Event Points**: {item:Yellow Rubber Duck}, {item:Red Rubber Duck}, {item:Green Rubber Duck}, {item:Blue Rubber Duck}, {item:Purple Rubber Duck}, {item:Undead Rubber Duck}, {item:Mermaid Rubber Duck}, {item:Warrior Rubber Duck}, {item:Dark Rubber Duck} and {item:Orc Rubber Duck}.
Exchange Event Points: outfit, mount and more
Points can be exchanged at any phase of the event.
If your world completes all seven days, every character with at least **70 points** automatically enters a draw for extra prizes.
During the event you can earn five achievements: Aye-aye, Captain!, Principled, Rubber Ducking, Stakeholder and Sail Away!.
The tasks on days 3, 5 and 6 depend on other players: arrange it with friends or with whoever is at the shipyard.
